pk.context: 56 mg nasal, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Mean absolute bioavailability is about 48% after nasal spray, and it is 43% to 45% protein bound. It is cleared mainly by cytochrome P450 metabolism, with metabolites recovered mostly in urine.
clues.substance: A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 237.72. It is freely soluble in water.
clues.product: An NDA product of 28 mg per device, sold in 56 mg and 84 mg dose kits.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for sedation, dissociation, respiratory depression and abuse. Contraindicated with intracerebral hemorrhage or aneurysmal vascular disease; dissociation and dizziness are common.
clues.indication: Treatment-resistant depression in adults, alone or with an oral antidepressant, and depressive symptoms with acute suicidal ideation in major depressive disorder.
clues.mechanism: It is a non-selective, non-competitive antagonist of the NMDA receptor, an ionotropic glutamate receptor. The mechanism of its antidepressant effect is unknown.

tell: The S-enantiomer of ketamine, given as a nasal spray with at least two hours of monitoring after each dose.
